name: DX Toolkit Demo
description: Demonstrates ServiceInjector plugin usage and benefits.
project_description: DX Toolkit Demo is the example submodule of DX Toolkit. It exists to demonstrate the ServiceInjector factory-service pattern by shipping two ServiceInjector plugins (ViewStorage, and a derivative-driven ConfigFactory), a ContentAuditor service that consumes generated services (service_injector.node.storage, service_injector.taxonomy_term.storage, service_injector.user.storage, service_injector.system.site.config), and two Drush commands (dx:demo:audit and dx:demo:audit-type) that print site content statistics to the CLI. It depends on dx_toolkit, node, and taxonomy, targets Drupal 10 or 11, and is intended purely as reference/template code, not for production use. Note: the ServiceInjector runtime (a ServiceInjectorBase class and collecting manager) is not present in the dx_toolkit 1.0.1 release these plugins reference, so the demo services are illustrative.
